title: New Italian sketches

authorInfo.bio: John Addington Symonds (1840–1893) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "New Italian Sketches" by John Addington Symonds is a collection of travel essays written in the late 19th century. This work presents vivid sketches and reflections of the author's journeys through Italy, focusing on various locations and the experiences he encounters.
